title: Assistant Management Accountant
description:
About the Business

A great opportunity to join a well-established accountancy and business advisory firm based in Birmingham with hybrid working as an Assistant Management Accountant. The role sits within a supportive finance team and offers genuine exposure across the full finance function, from day-to-day transactional processing through to reporting, reconciliations, and wider group support.

Main Duties:

As an Assistant Management Accountant, your main duties include:
- Supporting month-end and year-end processes, including posting journals, accruals, and prepayments
- Preparing weekly cash flow figures for submission to the wider group
- Producing WIP reporting for review by fee earners
- Assisting with the preparation of the monthly management information pack
- Managing supplier payments and customer receipts, including direct debit administration and payment allocation
- Completing bank reconciliations and posting cashbook entries
- Maintaining monthly balance sheet control account reconciliations
- Monitoring aged debt and producing reports to support review meetings
- Processing employee expenses in line with company policy, ensuring documentation is properly retained
- Supporting VAT return preparation for group submission and maintaining records in line with HMRC requirements
- Assisting with payroll administration, including checking data and liaising with relevant teams
- Providing wider support to the group finance team, including managing shared finance inboxes

Location / Office / Culture

The role is based in Birmingham, within a friendly and close-knit finance team. You'll gain broad exposure across the finance function, working closely with colleagues, suppliers, and customers, while developing your skills in a supportive, team-focused environment.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience in a finance, accounts, or administrative role is desirable
- A good understanding of basic accounting principles, ledgers, and reconciliations
- Strong numerical skills with excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Confidence using Microsoft Excel and the wider Microsoft Office suite
- Experience with Sage Intacct is advantageous
- The ability to prioritise a varied workload and manage multiple deadlines
- Clear, professional communication skills with colleagues, suppliers, and customers
- Discretion and integrity when handling confidential financial information
- AAT qualified, or working towards AAT, ACCA, CIMA, or another relevant accounting qualification, is desirable

Why Join the Business
- Broad, hands-on exposure across the full finance function
- Support and encouragement towards a professional accounting qualification
- A friendly, close-knit, and team-focused finance department
- Genuine variety in day-to-day responsibilities
- The chance to build skills across reporting, reconciliations, and payroll support

About Us

We are a local accountancy recruitment specialist. We appreciate that roles are often online for a long period of time. If you want to check if this role is still live or just want more details before applying, call us directly.

Working in accordance with information governance, confidentiality, safeguarding and health and safety requirements. The Medical Receptionist/Care Navigator plays a crucial role in supporting patients by guiding them through the healthcare system, ensuring they receive the appropriate care and services. This position involves working closely with patients, GPs, and other healthcare professionals to coordinate care and improve patient outcomes. To be responsible for undertaking a wide range of reception duties and the provision of general support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties can include, but are not limited to, greeting and directing patients, effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, the processing of information and assisting patients as required. To act as the central point of contact for patients, be responsible for the distribution of information, messages and enquires for the clinical team and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. Appointment Coordination: Schedule and manage patient appointments, ensuring they are booked with the appropriate healthcare professional. Care Coordination: Work with GPs and other healthcare providers to coordinate patient care, including referrals to specialists and community services. Information Provision: Provide patients with information about available services, health resources, and self-care management.
